description: This file defines the implementation of an uplink processor for a radio communication system, including classes for handling PUSCH result notifications, task execution, and processing of uplink PDUs, as well as managing resources and slot processing.

classes.name: pusch_processor_result_notifier_adaptor
classes.description: Adapts PUSCH processor results to the upper PHY receive results notifier, handling control and data notifications.

classes.name: uplink_processor_impl
classes.description: Implements the uplink processing logic, managing resource grids, PDUs, and slot processing for uplink signals.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the notifier adaptor with the relevant notification interface, RNTI, slot, HARQ ID, payload, and callback.

methods.name: on_uci
methods.description: Handles UCI (Uplink Control Information) results, notifying the upper layer with control info.

methods.name: on_sch
methods.description: Handles scheduled data results, notifying the upper layer with data and invoking callback.

methods.name: get_pdu_slot_repository
methods.description: Returns the PDU slot repository for a given slot.

methods.name: get_slot_processor
methods.description: Returns the slot processor for a given slot.

methods.name: handle_rx_symbol
methods.description: Processes received symbols at the end of a symbol index.

methods.name: process_symbol_pdus
methods.description: Processes PDUs associated with received symbols, forwarding them to appropriate processors.

methods.name: notify_discard_pucch (overload)
methods.description: Notifies about discarded PUCCH Format 1 collections.
